=== hello
        global  main
        extern  puts
        section .text
main:
        sub     rsp, 40
        lea     rcx, [rel msg]
        call    puts
        xor     eax, eax
        add     rsp, 40
        ret
        section .rdata
msg:    db      "Hello from rsasm!", 0
=== externs and relocations
        default rel
        global  f, g
        extern  ext
        section .text
f:      call    ext
        call    g
        call    local1
        lea     rax, [data1]
        lea     rcx, [ext+4]
        mov     eax, [rel data1+8]
        jmp     f
g:      ret
local1: ret
.sub:   ret
        section .data
data1:  dq      f, g, local1, ext
        dd      ext wrt ..imagebase
        dd      f wrt ..imagebase
        dd      data1 wrt ..imagebase
=== standard sections
        section .text
        ret
        section .data
        dd      1
        section .rdata
        db      2
        section .bss
        resq    2
=== section attributes
        section .mysec
        db      2
        section .code2 code
        ret
        section .text2 text
        ret
        section .dat2 data align=8
        dq      3
        section .rd2 rdata align=2
        db      4
        section .b2 bss
        resb    5
        section .inf info
        db      'x'
        section .drectve info
        db      ' /export:f'
=== empty sections
        section .foo
        section .data
        section .text
        section .bar
x:
        section .baz
        db      1
=== data only
        section .data
x:      dd      1
=== absolute and common
        global  x
x       equ     5
        common  shared 16
        section .text
        mov     eax, x
        mov     rax, [rel shared]
=== pdata and xdata by name
        section .text
f:      ret
        section .xdata
        db      1, 0, 0, 0
        section .pdata
        dd      f wrt ..imagebase

=== extern: call foo
        extern  foo
        call foo
=== extern: call foo+4
        extern  foo
        call foo+4
=== extern: jmp foo
        extern  foo
        jmp foo
=== extern: jz foo
        extern  foo
        jz foo
=== extern: mov eax, [rel foo]
        extern  foo
        mov eax, [rel foo]
=== extern: mov dword [rel foo], 1
        extern  foo
        mov dword [rel foo], 1
=== extern: mov word [rel foo], 2
        extern  foo
        mov word [rel foo], 2
=== extern: mov byte [rel foo+3], 4
        extern  foo
        mov byte [rel foo+3], 4
=== extern: lea rax, [rel foo+8]
        extern  foo
        lea rax, [rel foo+8]
=== extern: mov rax, foo
        extern  foo
        mov rax, foo
=== extern: mov eax, foo
        extern  foo
        mov eax, foo
=== extern: mov rcx, [foo]
        extern  foo
        mov rcx, [foo]
=== extern: push qword [rel foo]
        extern  foo
        push qword [rel foo]
=== extern: dq foo
        extern  foo
        dq foo
=== extern: dq foo+9
        extern  foo
        dq foo+9
=== extern: dd foo
        extern  foo
        dd foo
=== extern: dd foo wrt ..imagebase
        extern  foo
        dd foo wrt ..imagebase
=== extern: dd foo+4 wrt ..imagebase
        extern  foo
        dd foo+4 wrt ..imagebase
